title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00604v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. translated_title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA：用于长时程操作的VLA模型记忆能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作策略通常只能看到最近的一帧或几帧画面，这使得难以评估它们如何利用在任务执行过程中会消失的信息。我们提出了MIKASA-Robo-VLA，这是一个包含90个语言条件操作任务的基准测试。其中除10个任务外，所有任务都会隐藏动作所依赖的线索，这10个任务作为反应式对照组。其重建的原始套件MIKASA-Robo包含32个任务，且仅在具有代表性的VLA子集中使用语言。在MIKASA-Robo-VLA中，每个任务都提供指令，而依赖记忆的任务会隐藏与任务相关的线索，反应式对照任务则保持线索始终可见。对于其中70个任务，环境阶段时间定义了信息间隔，其中28个任务的信息间隔超出了我们调研的最宽固定上下文VLA模型的16帧窗口。该间隔仅计算线索被证实缺失的时间区间，而非策略必须保留信息的全部时长，因此每个依赖记忆的任务在构建上都必然需要记忆能力，包括那些其测量……
tldr: 提出了MIKASA-Robo-VLA基准测试，包含90个语言条件操作任务，通过在大多数任务中隐藏动作所依赖的关键线索，系统性地评估视觉-语言-动作模型在长时程操作中的记忆能力。
en_tdlr: MIKASA-Robo-VLA introduces a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks that hide task-relevant cues to systematically evaluate the memory capabilities of vision-language-action models in long-horizon manipulation.
